dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello! The land here doesn't look like the other places. Is there some special purpose for it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Why isn't he responding? Did he not hear Paimon?

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Guh... N—Nara?

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: H—How? Why is there a Nara in Vanarana? Are they here to catch me and roast me? Arakara is not as tasty as mushrooms...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, who do you think we are to do such a horrible thing? We're known as "Aranara's happy partners"!

choices.text: No one has ever said that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, even no one said it, they must feel it deep down. It goes without saying!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anyway, this is Paimon, and the golden one here is {NICKNAME}. {PLAYERAVATAR#SEXPRO[INFO_MALE_PRONOUN_HE|INFO_FEMALE_PRONOUN_SHE]} is a good Nara!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You are Arakara, right? What are you doing here on your own?

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Why is Paimon asking this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Paimon is just curious! Like the instinct to jump at a butterfly, or catch a lizard. It's instinct...

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Is Paimon a cat that can fly?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: NO!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... If it's something you don't feel okay to tell us, like Aranara secrets, then never mind. We are not that insensitive, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm still curious though.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon guesses so...

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Secret? Arakara has no secrets. Arakara is not doing anything, Arakara is waiting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Waiting? You mean for other Aranara?

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Aranakula, went with Arapandu to Ashavan Realm, don't know when they return. Varuna Contraption is not well, not the time to tend to the nursery, yep.

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: #Does Nara {NICKNAME} like farming?

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: It's only troublesome in Valuka. It's not troublesome in Vana.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't you ask Paimon?

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Paimon catches butterflies and lizards, and doesn't look like the type to like farming. Asking is useless.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't quite agree... but Paimon cares more about the result than the process, okay? So, what do you grow in the nursery here? Is it tasty?

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Tasty, but also used for something else.

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: But now, if Paimon is hungry, don't come to the nursery to eat but go eat the mushrooms. There are way too many mushrooms in Vana. It will be good to eat some.

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Anyway, Aranakula is not back yet, and nothing can be started.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Okay, looks like we have to wait for Aranakula to come back. Let's go, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Great! Arakara too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hee-hee...

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: Mushrooms are yummy! ...Nara? Yummy? No, Nara can't eat.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon? Aranakula followed Arapandu to Ashavan Realm and still hasn't returned, so why don't we eat some mushrooms now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Aranakula! He's returned to Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, and Paimon! The Varuna Contraption has been healed. Aranakula can now focus on the nursery.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the nursery that Aranakula always talks about.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Yes, it's the nursery that Aranakula and Arakara take care of together. The soil here was suitable for growing happy Viparyas.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are there unhappy Viparyas?

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: They are not unhappy, just not as happy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: It's like having soil that's suitable for growth, and there is no lack of rain and sunlight, and no obstacles to growth... There seems nothing to be unhappy about, but also not anything to be very happy about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm... Feels plain and ordinary. Eh? So is this place different from the other places?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: The soil in Vanarana, all very good, but here is particularly good. And more importantly...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Arakara and Aranakula will look after them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look after... in what way, specifically?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Will play music to them.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: And compliment their beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this the difference between wild and domesticated Viparyas...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can relate... It's hard not to be happy when there is pleasant music to listen to every day and to be praised daily for your beauty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Right, just like Paimon. Before Paimon was fished out by {NICKNAME}, Paimon wasn't unhappy, but not that happy either...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #After Paimon started traveling with {NICKNAME}, we've met with many difficulties, but when Paimon is happy, Paimon sometimes feels extra happy!

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Paimon is quite right. Arakara is going to make beautiful lights with the happy Viparyas for Festival Utsava.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, since Aranakula is also back, we should hurry and get started! The seeds of Viparyas... Do Viparyas have seeds too?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Viparyas, is the earth's balderdash, is what the earth remembers in dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That seed...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Viparyas has no seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But how do you have a nursery without seeds... Ah! Could Aranakula have some Ararakalari that can grow Viparyas out of thin air?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: No, Paimon is wrong... To make the nursery grow Viparyas, Vasmrti is needed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Vas... what now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Vasmrti.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Vanarana will remember everything, so, with Vasmrti, the earth will remember again in a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: The nursery will also birth happy Viparyas.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh... Th—Then this Vasmrti can only be obtained by Aranara? So does that mean {NICKNAME} and Paimon have no chance to grow Viparyas in the nursery...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #The Golden Nara helped Aranakula and other Aranara. The Golden Nara is Aranara friend, so Aranakula and Nara {NICKNAME} will cultivate Viparyas together.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Let Vasmrti sink into the soil, and Viparyas will be birthed. Nara {NICKNAME}, try it.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You follow what Aranakula said and let the Vasmrti sink into the soil.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's it? It doesn't seem to be any different from growing other plants! Put the seed in the soil, then wait for the seed to grow...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Vasmrti is not a seed. Just like Paimon is not a flying cat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm... O—Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, the nursery still has a lot of space left. One, two, three... Whoa, there are twelve spots for growing Viparyas! Do you have more Vasmrti, Aranakula?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Used to, but not anymore, need to collect again.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Outside the dream world, there are 12 nurseries that condense Vasmrti. With them, the Vanarana nursery will be full of Viparyas.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Festival Utsava needs lots of Viparyas, and Vanarana has a lot of them. But if there are more happy Viparyas. Aranara will be happy. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon will be happy too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, let's help collect Vasmrti! But how do we collect this thing? Arakara just said earlier that it's in the nursery outside of the dream world...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Golden Nara, still need to traverse the land of the nursery. Once is okay. Too many times, no.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Only one trip is needed... And then, the nursery soil will bear Vasmrtis, like dew that gathers on the leaves in the sunrise after a night of rain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Paimon doesn't get it at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But based on the experience of dealing with Aranara before... When we find the nursery outside the dream world, we should be able to know what Aranakula is saying.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, then we should look around when we find a nursery!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Aranakula! Made it back to Vanarana, and... with an unknown Aranara!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
